field_classifications: Keep original per-field provenance; external replacement and estimates are not KR-confirmed

basis: existing items at similar required level/type
known guide price and known damage/armor stats

rules.buy: known vendor buy, else known guide listed price, else max(5,level^2*12)
rules.level: existing; else special/gold tier 50, iron 20, other 1
rules.quest_trade: not sold by vendors; account quest consume only
rules.source_asset_identity: Known bindings preserved; category-level original sprite replacement for unknown identity

rules.hp: 25 + level^2*9 + sqrt(XP)*3; named boss x4, only when unknown

rules.extra_acquisition: closest compatible level monster; inferred, not source drop
rules.selection: independent rolls; known exact ratio retained

basis: source map byte-count dimensions and inherited verified dimensions

rules.collision: original 4-bit masks retained, mask15 solid; directional mapping requires importer capability
rules.ecology: source name family + XP level; inferred original role
rules.entry: largest original walkable component; no pixel changes
rules.history: Original NA geography, not verified KR1998 layout
rules.links: authored connected routes, two-way return portals in same reachable component

rules.dialogue: New Korean functional dialogue, not quoted historical dialogue
rules.placements: walkable reachable cell with interaction neighbor; mutual-exclusive same-name/location variants
rules.shops: ordinary goods by shop role; exact source prices kept
rules.unknown_role: craft/material exchange rather than functionless dialogue

basis: known learn costs, level, healing, damage

rules.HP: known absolute/fraction; never permit suicide at cast
rules.damage: known; otherwise max(20,level^2*5) times named melee multiplier
rules.duration: 0 instant, known duration for status, otherwise 30s
rules.target: solo effects for summon/recall are explicitly labelled offline replacements
rules.unknown_effect: deterministic category fallback, historical identity unverified

rules.HP_MP: retain source ranges; fill missing range from nearest same-class row
rules.novice: preserve existing levels1–5; selected classes have full1–99 tables
rules.terminal: level99 exp_to_next=0; terminal has no level100

rules.exchange: explicit level99 XP-to-max-HP/MP exchange, not a claimed historical formula
rules.missing_MP: warrior0, rogue90000 at rank3; source known thresholds retained
rules.quest: authored solo collection/kill quest, once, separate completion key per job/rank

rules.consume: collection objective item is atomically consumed at completion
rules.repeat: daily quest 24h cooldown, occurrence counter, one completion transaction ID
rules.reward: XP/gold and level-compatible item; once per unique quest

rules.consume: gold and material on each attempt, before outcome
rules.failure: early retain, stages5–8 downgrade,9–10 may destroy; exclusive rational probabilities
rules.stats: one scalar per-item instance, base definition unchanged

rule: ROUND_HALF_UP integer XP8; conditional expected value7.5; source files untouched
